title: Learning Nonlinear Finite Element Solution Operators using Multilayer Perceptrons and Energy Minimization
abstract: arXiv:2412.04596v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We develop and evaluate a method for learning solution operators to nonlinear problems governed by partial differential equations (PDEs). The approach is based on a finite element discretization and aims at representing the solution operator by a multilayer perceptron (MLP) that takes problem data variables as input and gives a prediction of the finite element solution as output. The variables will typically correspond to parameters in a parametrization of input data such as boundary conditions, coefficients, and right-hand sides. The output will be an approximation of the corresponding finite element solution, thus enabling support and enhancement by the standard finite element method (FEM) both theoretically and practically. translated_title: 基于多层感知机与能量最小化的非线性有限元解算子学习
translated_abstract: 我们开发并评估了一种用于学习由偏微分方程（PDE）所支配的非线性问题解算子的方法。该方法基于有限元离散化，旨在利用多层感知机（MLP）来表示解算子，该感知机以问题数据变量作为输入，并输出对有限元解的预测。这些变量通常对应于输入数据参数化中的参数，例如边界条件、系数和右端项。其输出为相应有限元解的近似，从而在理论和实践上均可获得标准有限元方法（FEM）的支持与增强。我们专注于使用与偏微分方程相对应的能量泛函作为损失函数，因为这使我们能够制定高效的、可并行化的训练算法，该算法基于在每个单元上局部组装能量……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种利用多层感知机表示解算子、并以偏微分方程的能量泛函作为损失函数来学习非线性偏微分方程有限元解算子的方法，从而实现可并行化的高效训练，并与标准有限元方法在理论和实践上相互兼容。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a method that learns finite element solution operators for nonlinear PDEs by representing them with multilayer perceptrons and using the PDE energy functional as the loss function, enabling efficient parallelizable training compatible with standard finite element methods.
